title: ComfyUI EXIF and Metadata Viewer: Extract Workflow JSON | AICheck365
description: Inspect original ComfyUI PNG files for prompt, workflow JSON, node graph data, Stable Diffusion parameters, model names, seed, sampler, CFG, and dimensions.
h1: ComfyUI Metadata Viewer: extract workflow JSON, prompt and model settings
eyebrow: High-intent tool guide · United States / English
lead: ComfyUI generation data is normally stored in PNG text chunks, not traditional camera EXIF. With the original PNG, AICheck365 can expose the prompt and workflow JSON, node graph, checkpoint and LoRA names, seed, sampler, scheduler, steps, CFG, and output dimensions without uploading the image.

direct.heading: Quick answer: ComfyUI metadata lives in PNG prompt and workflow chunks
direct.body: Use the original PNG and inspect its tEXt, iTXt, and zTXt chunks. A prompt chunk describes the executed graph and parameters; a workflow chunk preserves the editable node layout. If those chunks are missing, the image may have been re-exported, optimized, converted, or stripped.

evidenceRows: Can preserve both prompt and workflow JSON and is the best source for reproducibility.
May retain prompt data but lose workflow layout, depending on the export path.
Detailed and reproducible, but unsigned and therefore editable.
signalRows: Executed nodes, inputs, checkpoint, sampler, scheduler, seed, steps, CFG, and dimensions.
Canvas layout, links, widgets, node types, and values needed to reopen the graph.
Checkpoint, VAE, LoRA, ControlNet, upscaler, and custom-node values when embedded.
The report shows which tEXt/iTXt/zTXt block produced each result.
steps: Use the PNG saved directly by ComfyUI.
Inspect prompt and workflow separately; search model, seed, sampler, CFG, or node names.
Export full JSON only when you need to reproduce or audit the workflow.
limits: ComfyUI metadata can be removed by Save Image alternatives, optimizers, screenshots, and social uploads.
Workflow JSON may expose private prompts, local model names, or internal paths; review before sharing.
An empty result does not rule out ComfyUI because metadata may have been stripped.
faq: Is ComfyUI metadata stored in EXIF?
Usually no. It is primarily stored in PNG text chunks named prompt and workflow.
Can the viewer rebuild the workflow?
It extracts the embedded JSON; whether it reopens cleanly depends on installed custom nodes and models.
Yes. The PNG is read locally in your browser.
